z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan x=2, jimillar tazara ita ce 1+1=2. A wannan karon k=2 ne. Ka gwada wasu darajoji kamar 1.5 ko 2.5 da kanka.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ga x daga 1 zuwa 3, |x−1|=x−1 kuma |x−3|=3−x, saboda haka jimillar (x−1)+(3−x)=2 ce, ba ta canzawa ko wace x ce. Don haka akwai mafita marasa iyaka.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka riga ka lissafa jimillar 2 ce idan x=2. Ka sake duba wannan bayanin.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mafita biyu ne kawai, x=1 da x=3
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Gaskiya ne jimillar 2 ce a x=1 da x=3, amma ka saka darajojin da ke tsakaninsu da kanka domin dubawa.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mafita guda ɗaya ce kawai, x=2
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Baya ga x=2, saka wasu darajoji kamar 1.5 ka lissafa jimillar.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Idan ka saka darajoji da dama tsakanin 1 da 3 da kanka, za ka iya duba ko jimillar tana nan 2.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Tuna abin da ka koya lokacin k=2. Saka lambobin da suka kasa 1 ko suka fi 3 da kanka, ka lissafa jimillar.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane zangon k ne ke ba da mafita 2 daidai?
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan k>2, akwai mafita ɗaya a wajen zangon a hagu da ɗaya a dama, don haka 2 ne. Idan k=2, mafita ba su da iyaka; idan k<2, babu. Hukuncinka na farko na “2” ga k=4 yana da alaƙa da wannan ƙarshe.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Jimillar tazara aƙalla 2 ce; domin ta zama darajar da ta fi 2, akwai maki ɗaya a kowane gefe wajen zangon.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan k=2, ba mafita 2 ake samu ba, sai dai marasa iyaka.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: k ya fi 0 kuma ya kasa 4
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: An samu mafita 2 ga k=4, saboda haka dole ne a samu 2 ga 4 ko fiye.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Jimillar mafi ƙarancin ƙima 2 ce, don haka idan k<2 babu mafita.
z-m-25-04.s.s1.reflect: Hukuncinka na farko na mafita 2 idan k=4 bai canza ba, ya zama wani misali na ƙa'ida mafi faɗi. Amma idan k=2, an gyara tunanin 'maki biyu' da sabon bayani. A wane mataki ka riƙe hukunci, kuma a wane ka gyara?
z-m-25-04.s.s2.prompt: Idan k=2, rubuta zangon x da dukkan mafita suke ciki, sannan ka bayyana wa aboki dalilin da ya sa ba 'biyu' ba ne.
z-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x=1, x=3, da x=2 ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka lissafta jimillar.
z-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ga x tsakanin su, cire alamun ƙima cikakke daga |x−1| da |x−3| sannan ka tara furucin.
z-m-25-04.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Duk x da ... mafita ne, saboda ...
z-m-25-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin ka lissafta ko ƙarshen zangonka (1 da 3) duka mafita ne?
z-m-25-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ka zaɓi maki ɗaya a cikin tazara ka lissafta ko jimillar gaske 2 ce?
z-m-25-04.s.s2.model.0: Dukkan lambobi daga 1 zuwa 3 mafita ne. Misali x=2 yana ba da 1+1=2, x=1.5 kuma 0.5+1.5=2. Tsakanin 1 da 3, duk abin da gefe ɗaya ya ƙaru, ɗayan yana raguwa da adadi ɗaya, saboda haka jimillar koyaushe 2 ce.
z-m-25-04.s.s2.model.1: Mafita ita ce 1≤x≤3. A cikin wannan zangon |x−1|=x−1 da |x−3|=3−x, idan aka tara x yana soke juna kuma koyaushe 2 ne.

z-m-25-01.title: Idan mun san jimillar tushen kawai, ma'auni ya kayyadu kuwa?
z-m-25-01.topic: Alaƙar tushen da ma'aunan ma'aunin murabba'i: bayanin da aka bayar ya isa kuwa?
z-m-25-01.goal: Ka yanke hukunci ko bayanin guda ɗaya, jimillar tushen biyu, yana kayyade ma'aunin murabba'i ya zama guda ɗaya; ƙirƙiri ma'aunai daban-daban da suka cika sharaɗi iri ɗaya ka kwatanta su, sannan ka bayyana ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata.
z-m-25-01.material: Akwai ma'aunin murabba'i x²+bx+c=0 mai ma'aunai na ainihi (x murabba'i da aka ƙara b sau x da c daidai yake da 0). Abin da aka sani kawai shi ne wannan ma'auni yana da tushen ainihi biyu daban-daban kuma jimillarsu 3 ce. Jiu ya ce, ‘Jimillar 3 ce, don haka b da c duk sun kayyadu. Akwai ma'auni guda ɗaya kawai irin wannan.’

z-m-25-01.s.s1.o.a: Idan jimillar 3 ce, an ƙayyade b da c duka, saboda haka ma'auni guda ɗaya ne kawai.

z-m-25-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka yanke hukuncin ƙarancin bayani ta lura cewa jimilla da ninkawa suna da alaƙa da ma'aunai mabambanta.

z-m-25-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin cewa sharaɗin jimillar 3 yana hana samun tushen ainihi. Ka nemo misali da kanka mai jimillar 3 da tushen ainihi domin dubawa.

z-m-25-01.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ma'aunai 3 mabambanta x²+bx+c=0 inda b da c suka cika duk sharuɗɗan nan: jimillar tushen biyu 3 ce, kuma yana da tushen ainihi biyu mabambanta.

z-m-25-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Da wannan b, jimillar tushen biyu ba 3 ba ce.

z-m-25-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba shi da tushen ainihi biyu mabambanta (duba bambancin murabba'i).

Akwai ma'aunai da yawa, saboda haka “guda ɗaya kawai” ba daidai ba ne. Misali: (b,c)=(−3,2), tushen 1 da 2 ne. Jimilla ita ce 3.

z-m-25-09.title: Shin P(1) da P(3) kaɗai za su iya kayyade saura?
z-m-25-09.topic: Ka'idar saura: bayanin da ke kayyade saura guda ɗaya
z-m-25-09.goal: Ka bambanta bayanin da za a iya amfani da shi wajen kayyade saura da wanda ba zai iya ba, sannan ka karyata kuskure ta ƙirƙirar saura daban-daban da suka cika bayanin iri ɗaya.
z-m-25-09.material: Saura R(x) idan aka raba furucin aljabara P(x) da (x−1)(x−2) furuci ne ax+b mai daraja 1 ko ƙasa da haka. Ba a san furucin P(x) ba, kuma ana iya bayar da wasu ƙimomin P(x) kawai. (a da b lambobi na ainihi ne)
z-m-25-09.thinking.1: Nemo musanya ƙima ba tare da hujja ba a warwarewa
z-m-25-09.prereq.1: Ka san furucin rabon P(x)=B(x)Q(x)+R(x) da darajar saurar.
z-m-25-09.prereq.2: Ka san ka'idar saura (saura idan aka raba P(x) da x−a ita ce P(a)).
z-m-25-09.s.s1.prompt: Wanne daga cikin bayanan nan ne ke kayyade saura R(x) ya zama guda ɗaya?
z-m-25-09.s.s1.hint.0: A cikin P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b, saka sanannun ƙimomin x, sannan ka lura da abin da ke faruwa da kalmar rabon Q(x).
z-m-25-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka ƙidaya ma'aunai nawa game da a da b za ka iya kafawa daga bayanin kowane zaɓi.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin ko a da b sun kayyadu su zama guda ɗaya idan bayani guda ɗaya ne kawai. Akwai ma'aurata (a, b) da yawa masu a+b=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da bayanin ƙimomin biyu da ke sa mai rabawa (x−1)(x−2) ya zama 0.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.c: Wataƙila wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da bayanin x=3 kai tsaye ga saura, ko da ba ƙima ce da ke sa mai rabawa ya zama 0 ba. Ka bincika ko ɓangaren rabon a furucin rabawa ya zama 0 idan x=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan bayanin ba ya haɗa ko ɗaya daga cikin ƙimomin da ke sa mai rabawa ya zama 0. Ka yi tunanin ko za ka iya kafa ma'aunai game da a da b da wannan bayanin.
z-m-25-09.s.s1.explain: A cikin P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b, saka x=1 da x=2 yana kawar da tasirin rabon, saboda haka P(1)=a+b da P(2)=2a+b. Idan ka san waɗannan ƙimomi biyu, a da b sun kayyadu (a=2, b=1).
z-m-25-09.s.s2.prompt: Wani ɗalibi ya nemo saura ta amfani da ‘P(1)=3, P(3)=7’ kawai. Zaɓi layin da ba daidai ba a warwarewar.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ka rubuta furucin P(3)=2Q(3)+3a+b da aka samu ta saka x=3, sannan ka kwatanta shi da layi na 3.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka lissafta ƙimar (x−1)(x−2) idan aka saka x=1 da kuma idan aka saka x=3 cikin furucin layi na 1.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.0: Idan rabon P(x) da (x−1)(x−2) shi ne Q(x), saura kuma ax+b, to P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.1: Saka x=1 yana ba da P(1)=a+b, saboda haka a+b=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.2: Saka x=3 yana ba da P(3)=3a+b, saboda haka 3a+b=7.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.line.3: Warware ma'aunai biyun yana ba da a=2, b=1, don haka saura shi ne 2x+1.
z-m-25-09.s.s2.explain: A layi na 3, idan aka saka x=3, (x−1)(x−2)Q(3)=2Q(3) ba 0 ba ne, amma an cire kalmar rabon. Saboda haka 3a+b=7 ba lallai ya zama gaskiya ba. Ƙarshe a layi na 4 ma ya dogara da wannan.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.prompt: Akwai furucin P(x) masu P(1)=3 da P(3)=7 waɗanda saurar su ba 2x+1 ba ne. Idan saura ax+b ne, ƙirƙiri ma'aurata (a, b) daban-daban guda 3 da furuci irin wannan zai iya samu. (Kada a haɗa a=2.)
z-m-25-09.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko ka rubuta alaƙar da ke tsakanin a da b idan ka bayyana P(1)=3 ta fuskar saura.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ka bincika ko P(3)=7 zai iya cika idan ka ɗauki rabon Q a matsayin adadi tsayayye.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.var.a: Ma'aunin a na x a cikin saura
z-m-25-09.s.s3.var.b: Adadin tsayayye b a cikin saura
z-m-25-09.s.s3.ok.c1: P(1)=3 ma yana aiki ga saurar (a+b=3).
z-m-25-09.s.s3.fail.c1: Ka sake bincika abin da a+b dole ya zama domin P(1)=3.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.fail.c2: Idan a=2 ne, b=1 ne kuma saura 2x+1 ne. Nemo wasu ƙimomi.
z-m-25-09.s.s3.explain: Idan aka ɗauki P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q+ax+b (Q adadi tsayayye ne), to P(1)=a+b=3 da P(3)=2Q+3a+b=7. Idan a+b=3, za ka iya cika da Q=2−a; saboda haka ko a ba 2 ba ne, akwai furucin aljabara da ke cika sharuɗɗan biyu. Misali, idan a=1, b=2, Q=1, to P(x)=x²−2x+4, kuma P(1)=3, P(3)=7, amma saura x+2 ne.

z-m-25-03.title: Maganin Seoyun da ta ninka ɓangarorin biyu: a ina ne aka karkata?
z-m-25-03.topic: Rashin daidaito mai juzu'i: duba maganin da ya ninka da furucin da ba a san alamarsa ba
z-m-25-03.goal: Gwada ta hanyar saka darajoji maganin da ya ce mafita ita ce “dukkan lambobin ainihi sai 2”, nemo layin da maganin ya karkata, sannan nemo madaidaicin mafita.
z-m-25-03.material:
Seoyun ta warware rashin daidaiton x/(x−2)>1 (x raba da x−2 ya fi 1). Duk lambobi na ainihi ne, kuma x ba 2 ba ne. Ga maganinta.
1. Ninka ɓangarorin biyu da x−2: x>x−2
2. Sake tsara yana ba da 0>−2, wanda kullum gaskiya ne.
3. Saboda haka duk lambobin ainihi masu x−2≠0 mafita ne.
4. Amsa: x duk lambobin ainihi ne sai 2.

z-m-25-05.material:
Dalibai biyu sun warware √(2x+3)=x. Duk lambobi ainihi ne.
Gaeun: Yin murabba'i a ɓangarorin biyu yana ba da x²−2x−3=0, wato x=3 ko x=−1. Idan an saka su cikin ma'aunin asali, x=3 kaɗai ne ke aiki (√9=3).
Doyun: Ƙimar tushen murabba'i aƙalla 0 ce, don haka na fara rubuta x≥0. Yin murabba'i yana ba da x=3 ko x=−1, kuma wanda ya cika x≥0 shi ne 3.
Amsoshin biyu x=3 ne. (2, 3)

z-m-25-08.material: Ana jefa ƙwallo sama daga ƙasa; tsayinta bayan t daƙiƙa h(t)=−5t²+20t (mita). Muna la'akari da ƙwallon daga jifa (t=0) har ta sake taɓa ƙasa (t=4). Muna duba lokutan da tsayin ya kai 15 m ko fiye da 10 m ko ƙasa. √1.2 kusan 1.095 ne, √2 kuma kusan 1.414.
z-m-25-08.thinking.1: Gyara zangon mafita idan sharudda sun canza
z-m-25-08.prereq.1: Za ka iya warware rashin daidaiton quadratic ta danganta shi da jadawalin aikin quadratic.
z-m-25-08.prereq.2: Za ka iya canza mafita mai tushen murabba'i zuwa ƙima kusan.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.prompt: Yi hasashen zangon t duk lokacin da yanayin ya canza.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa h(t) idan t=0,1,2,3,4, ka yi tebur sannan ka bayyana siffar jadawali da kalmomi. (0, 1, 2, 3)
z-m-25-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan nemo t inda jadawali ya haɗu da layin 15 m ko 10 m, saka maki guda don duba ko tsakanin su ko wajensu ne ke cika sharadin.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Ga wane zangon t ne tsayi aƙalla 15 m?
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zaɓi zangon t da tsayin ya kai 15 m ko fiye.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.after: −5t²+20t≥15 yana nufin t²−4t+3≤0, wato (t−1)(t−3)≤0, saboda haka 1≤t≤3. Mafi girman tsayi 20 m ne a ƙulli t=2, kuma lokacin da tsayin ya kai aƙalla 15 m daƙiƙa 2 ne.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ga parabola mai buɗewa zuwa ƙasa, ka manta cewa ‘ko fiye’ yana tsakanin tushen biyun, ka zaɓi wajen su.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya lura cewa tun da parabola tana buɗewa zuwa ƙasa, ɓangaren da tsayinsa ya fi girma yana tsakanin tushen biyun.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana ganin tsawo yana ƙaruwa koyaushe yayin da lokaci ke wucewa. Ka lissafta tsawo a t=4.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya kalli lokacin da tsawo ke ƙaruwa a farko kawai. Ka lissafta tsawo a t=2 ma.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Hannun da ake jifa da shi yana da tsayin 1 m sama da ƙasa, saboda haka furucin ya canza zuwa h(t)=−5t²+20t+1.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya tsawon lokacin da tsayin yake 15 m ko fiye ya kwatanta da daƙiƙa 2 na asali?
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.after: −5t²+20t+1≥15 ya zama 5t²−20t+14≤0, tushen su ne t=2±√1.2, kuma kusan 0.90≤t≤3.10. Tsawon lokacin 2√1.2≈2.19 s ne, ya fi na farko tsawo.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki furucin a matsayin siffa iri ɗaya, don haka tsawon zangon lokacin ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ya fi guntu da na farko
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana tunanin yayin da tsawo ke ƙaruwa, lokacin da yake 15 m ko fiye yana raguwa.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ya fi tsawo da na farko
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana tunanin ɗaga parabola yana faɗaɗa tazara tsakanin wuraren da ta haɗu da layin 15 m.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Parabola tana buɗewa zuwa ƙasa, don haka ɓangaren ‘ko fiye’ yana haɗuwa ya zama zangon lokaci guda.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Ka koma ga furucin asali h(t)=−5t²+20t, wannan karon kuma ka nemo lokacin da tsawo yake 10 m ko ƙasa da haka. Yanayin ya fara ne daga lokacin jifa har sai ya taɓa ƙasa, wato 0≤t≤4.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane zangon lokaci ne ya dace da tsayin 10 m ko ƙasa da haka?
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.after: −5t²+20t≤10 ya zama t²−4t+2≥0, mafitar kuma t≤2−√2 ko t≥2+√2 ce. Amsar yanayin ita ce ɓangaren wannan da ke cikin 0≤t≤4 kawai.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya zaɓi zanguna na waje na parabola sannan ya taƙaita su ga kewayon yanayin 0≤t≤4.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana ɗaukar ‘ko ƙasa da haka’ a matsayin tsakanin tushen biyu. A t=2, tsawon 20 m ne, saboda haka ba 10 m ko ƙasa da haka ba ne.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: t≤2−√2 ko t≥2+√2 (ga dukkan lambobin ainihi t)
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mafitar rashin daidaiton murabba'i daidai ce, amma lokutan marasa kyau ko lokutan da suka wuce daƙiƙa 4 ba sa cikin wannan yanayin.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka manta cewa tsawo ma 10 m ko ƙasa da haka ne nan da nan bayan jifa. Ka lissafta tsawo a t=0.1.
z-m-25-08.s.s1.reflect: Zangon farko 1≤t≤3 ya riƙe tunanin ‘tsakanin tushen biyu’ ko da furucin ya canza, tsawon zangon kawai ya sauya. A mataki na ƙarshe, dole ne a taƙaita mafita domin ta dace da ‘kewayon yanayin’. Waɗanne hukunci aka riƙe, kuma waɗanne aka gyara?
z-m-25-08.s.s2.prompt: Lokacin da hannun jifa ya ɗaga da 1 m, lokacin da tsawo ya kasance 15 m ko fiye ya ƙaru. Ka bayyana dalilin a jimloli ɗaya ko biyu ta amfani da siffar zane ko furucin.
z-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka kwatanta zanen kafin da bayan ƙara 1 ga h(t) a layin 15 m.
z-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka lissafta ka kwatanta tazarar tsakanin wuraren da kowace parabola ta haɗu da layin 15 m.
z-m-25-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Bayani na ya ambaci ‘wurare biyun da parabola da aka ɗaga sama ta haɗu da layin 15 m’ kuwa?
z-m-25-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Bayani na ya yi daidai da tsawon zangon da aka lissafta ta furuci (kusan 2.19 s) kuwa?
z-m-25-08.s.s2.model.0: An ɗaga parabola mai siffa iri ɗaya da 1 m, saboda haka tazara tsakanin wuraren da ta haɗu da layin 15 m ta faɗaɗa. Don haka lokacin da tsawo ya kai 15 m ko fiye ya ƙaru.
z-m-25-08.s.s2.model.1: A fuskar furuci, tsawon tsakanin tushen biyu na 5t²−20t+14≤0 shi ne 2√1.2, wanda ya fi 2. Yayin da tsawon ya tashi, lokacin sama da tsayin 15 m ɗin ya ƙaru.

z-m-25-12.prereq.0: Wannan aiki yana ɗauka ka koyi ma'aunai da rashin daidaito a Lissafi na gama-gari na babbar sakandare. ‘H3’ rarrabawa ce bisa wahalar wannan rukunin samarwa kawai, ba yana nufin an ware wannan abun cikin ga wani aji ba.
z-m-25-12.title: Yaya yawan lissafin kubik ne duk tushensu uku lambobi cikakku?
z-m-25-12.topic: Tushen lambobi cikakku na lissafin kubik: nemo dukkan ƙimomin ma'aunai da za su yiwu
z-m-25-12.goal: Da sharadin cewa duk tushen ukun lambobi cikakku ne, nemo wasu tarin tushen lambobi uku da za su yiwu, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa lissafin daidaiton da za su yiwu yana da iyaka.
z-m-25-12.material: Ga lissafin kubik x³+ax²+bx−6=0 (x mai ƙarfi 3, x mai ƙarfi 2, b x ragi 6 daidai yake da 0) inda a da b lambobi cikakku ne. Muna neman yanayin da tushen wannan lissafi ukun duk lambobi cikakku ne. Ana iya samun tushen da suka maimaitu.
z-m-25-12.thinking.0: Tantance waɗanda za su iya yiwuwa
z-m-25-12.thinking.1: Nemo wasu mafita da suka cika sharuddan
z-m-25-12.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yawan yanayin yana da iyaka
z-m-25-12.prereq.1: Ka san alaƙar da ke tsakanin tushen ukun da ma'aunai na lissafin kubik (alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai).
z-m-25-12.prereq.2: Ka san masu raba lambobi cikakku.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.prompt: Idan duk tushen ukun lambobi cikakku ne, zaɓi lambar da ba za ta iya zama ɗaya daga cikin tushen ba.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.hint.0: Saka tushen lamba cikakkiya r a cikin lissafin, tattara 6 na ƙayyadadden ɓangare a gefe ɗaya, sannan ka duba ko za ka iya fitar da r a matsayin ma'auni.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo ninkawar tushen ukun, ka duba alaƙarsa da 6.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.a: Idan −6 tushen ne, to −216+36a−6b−6=0, saboda haka yana yiwuwa idan b=6a−37. Masu raba 6 na ƙayyadadden ɓangare za su iya zama tushen.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.b: 2 mai raba 6 ne kuma zai iya zama tushen. Misali, akwai yanayin da tushen su ne 1, 2, 3.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.c: Wannan zaɓi ne da aka yi ta tunanin irin alaƙar da ƙimar dole ta kasance da ita da ƙayyadadden ɓangare idan tushen lamba cikakkiya ce.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.d: −1 mai raba 6 ne kuma zai iya zama tushen. Akwai yanayin da tushen su ne −1, −2, 3.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.explain: Idan akwai tushen lamba cikakkiya r, to r³+ar²+br=6, wato r(r²+ar+b)=6, saboda haka r dole ya zama mai raba 6. 4 ba mai raba 6 ba ne, don haka ba zai iya zama tushen ba.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.prompt: Ka rubuta tushen ukun daga mafi ƙanƙanta a matsayin r1≤r2≤r3, sannan ka nemo (r1, r2, r3) guda 4 daban-daban inda duk tushen ukun lambobi cikakku ne kuma tushen lissafin x³+ax²+bx−6=0 ne.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo dukkan tarin lambobi cikakku uku waɗanda ninkawarsu 6 ce, ka raba yanayin da dukansu masu kyau ne da yanayin da aka haɗa lambobi marasa kyau biyu.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane haɗin da ka samu, lissafta ninkawar tushen ukun ka tabbatar cewa 6 ce.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Duk tushen ukun lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne duk tushen ukun su zama lambobi cikakku.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.ok.c2: An rubuta su a jere daga mafi ƙanƙanta.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne a rubuta su a jere daga mafi ƙanƙanta zuwa mafi girma (ana iya samun ƙimomi iri ɗaya).
z-m-25-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Ninkawar tushen ukun 6 ce, wanda ya dace da ƙayyadadden ɓangare −6.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.fail.c3: Ƙayyadadden ɓangaren furucin da aka gina daga tushen ukun ba −6 ba ne.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.explain: Idan tushen ukun su ne r1, r2, r3, ƙayyadadden ɓangare shi ne −r1r2r3, saboda haka ninkawar ita ce 6. Yanayin da ninkawar lambobi cikakku uku ta zama 6 su ne (1,2,3), (1,1,6), (−1,−1,6), (−1,−2,3), (−1,−3,2), (−2,−3,1), (−6,−1,1), guda bakwai kenan. Misali, idan (1,2,3), to a=−6, b=11.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.prompt: Shin akwai (a, b) marasa iyaka ko masu iyaka da suka cika wannan sharadi? Ka rubuta ra'ayinka da dalili.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.hint.0: Daga sharadin cewa ninkawar tushen ukun 6 ce, ka yi tunanin yadda tushen guda ɗaya zai iya zama babba.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta duk yanayin da ka samu, sannan ka ƙirga su.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin yawan yanayin da na rubuta ya yi daidai da yawan da na ƙirga da gaske?
z-m-25-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana cewa musanya tsarin tushen ukun ana ɗauka a matsayin yanayi guda?
z-m-25-12.s.s3.model.0: Masu iyaka. Ninkawar tushen ukun tabbatacciya ce, 6, kuma haɗin lambobi cikakku uku da ninkawarsu 6 ce yana da iyaka, saboda haka (a, b) ma za su samu iyakantattun ƙimomi ne kawai.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.model.1: Masu iyaka. Ninkawar lambobi cikakku uku ita ce 6, saboda haka cikakkiyar ƙimar kowane tushe ba ta wuce 6 ba, kuma ana iya jera dukkan yanayin da za su yiwu; kusan 7 ne kawai.

z-m-25-13.title: Idan duka jimilla da ninkawa sun fi sifili, shin tushen biyun duka suna da kyau?
z-m-25-13.topic: Alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai: misalin da ke karyata cewa “jimilla da ninkawa suna da kyau”
z-m-25-13.goal: Nemo sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalin da ke karyata ikirarin nan: “idan jimilla da ninkawa duka suna da kyau, tushen biyun suna da kyau,” sannan ka gyara sharadin don ikirarin ya zama gaskiya.
z-m-25-13.material: Jisu ta ce game da lissafin murabba'i x²−px+q=0 (p da q lambobi ne na ainihi), “Idan jimilla p da ninkawa q duka suna da kyau, tushen biyun suna da kyau.” A matsayin hujja, ta ba da x²−5x+6=0 (tushen 2, 3) da x²−7x+10=0 (tushen 2, 5). A nan muna la'akari da tushen a cikin lambobi masu haɗaɗɗu.
z-m-25-13.thinking.0: Bambance misalan da ke karyata ikirari
z-m-25-13.thinking.2: Gyara sharadin da zai sa ikirari ya zama gaskiya
z-m-25-13.prereq.1: Ka san alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai (jimilla da ninkawar tushen biyu).
z-m-25-13.prereq.2: Ka san wariyar lissafin murabba'i da tushen zaton (tushen da ba lambobi na ainihi ba).
z-m-25-13.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi lissafin da zai iya zama misalin karyatawa ikirarin Jisu. (Misalin karyatawa dole ne ya cika zato na Jisu amma bai cika sakamakon ba.)
z-m-25-13.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta p da q na kowane lissafi, ka bar waɗanda suka cika zato na Jisu kawai (p>0, q>0).
z-m-25-13.s.s1.hint.1: Duba alamar wariyar lissafi na sauran lissafin don ganin ko tushen na ainihi ne.
z-m-25-13.s.s1.r.a: Da p=4, q=4, yana cika zato, amma tushen guda 2 ne (tushen ninki biyu), kuma mai kyau ne, don haka sakamakon ma ya cika. Ba misalin karyatawa ba ne.
z-m-25-13.s.s1.r.b: p=−3 ne, saboda haka bai cika zato ba (p>0). Don zama misalin karyatawa, dole ne ya cika zato.
z-m-25-13.s.s1.r.c: q=−4 mara kyau ne, saboda haka bai cika zato ba (q>0).
z-m-25-13.s.s1.r.d: Da jimilla p=2 da ninkawa q=5, yana cika zato, amma tushen su ne 1±2i, saboda haka sakamakon bai cika ba.
z-m-25-13.s.s1.explain: Jimilla 2 da ninkawa 5 duk suna da kyau, amma tushen ba na ainihi ba ne, 1±2i. Yana cika zato amma bai cika sakamakon ba, saboda haka misalin karyatawa ne.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri (p, q) guda 3 daban-daban na x²−px+q=0 inda p>0, q>0, amma tushen biyun ba duka suke da kyau ba. (p da q lambobi ne na ainihi.)
z-m-25-13.s.s2.hint.0: Bayan zaɓar p da q masu kyau, duba alamar p²−4q.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.hint.1: Rage p, ƙara q don alamar ta zama mara kyau.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.ok.c1: Jimilla da ninkawa duk suna da kyau.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne jimilla p da ninkawa q duka su zama masu kyau.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Tushen biyun ba na ainihi ba ne, saboda haka ba za a ce “duka suna da kyau” ba.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Da wannan (p, q), ba yanayi ba ne inda tushen biyun ba duka suke da kyau ba. Duba wariyar lissafin.
z-m-25-13.s.s2.explain: Idan p>0, q>0 kuma wariyar lissafi p²−4q<0, tushen zato ne, saboda haka “tushen biyun duka suna da kyau” ba gaskiya ba ne. (2,5) yana da tushen zato 1±2i, kuma (1,1) yana da tushen zato (−1±i√3)/2. Akasin haka, (5,6) yana da tushen 2, 3, duka masu kyau, saboda haka ba misalin karyatawa ba ne.
z-m-25-13.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta ikirarin Jisu don ya zama gaskiya. Ka rubuta sharadin da dole ne a ƙara da dalilin da ya sa tushen biyun za su zama masu kyau idan sharadin ya cika.
z-m-25-13.s.s3.hint.0: Ka rubuta irin halin da misalin karyatawa (2, 5) ya bambanta da shi wanda ya karya ikirarin.
z-m-25-13.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙara sharadin da zai hana wannan hali cikin layi guda.
z-m-25-13.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: A ƙara wa p>0, q>0, ...
z-m-25-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Idan ka yi amfani da sharadin da ka ƙara a kan misalin karyatawa na Jisu (2, 5), shin misalin karyatawar zai ɓace?
z-m-25-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin bayanin ya haɗa da alamun tushen biyun idan jimilla tana da kyau kuma ninkawa tana da kyau?
z-m-25-13.s.s3.model.0: Baya ga p>0, q>0, muna buƙatar sharadin cewa tushen na ainihi ne, wato wariyar lissafi p²−4q≥0. Tun da ninkawa mai kyau ce, tushen biyun suna da alama iri ɗaya; kuma jimilla mai kyau ce, don haka duka biyun masu kyau ne.
z-m-25-13.s.s3.model.1: Muna buƙatar ƙara sharadin cewa tushen biyun na ainihi ne. Idan tushen na ainihi ne kuma ninkawa mai kyau ce, suna da alama iri ɗaya; jimilla kuma mai kyau ce, saboda haka duka biyun masu kyau ne.
